ShortDescription.Value: Copy & paste props — select, move, rotate, blueprint and stamp groups of props

Publish.LongDescription:
## Copaste Copy and paste for props. Select a group, copy it, stamp it anywhere. Layout, rotation, heights and colors stay exactly as you built them.
## Features - **Click & marquee selection**: click props or drag a box on the ground, with live highlight while dragging. Works on props, decals and trees - **Copy & paste with preview**: the copied group follows your mouse as a ghost. Click to place, keep clicking to stamp more - **Original colors kept on paste**: pasted props keep their color variation and any custom color from the Customization tab, so a blue bench stays blue. If you want variety instead, flip the panel toggle to Random - **Align tools**: Line turns a messy selection into a clean row (equal gaps, everything facing the same way), To prop lines the row up on a reference prop you pick, Circle makes a circle. Grow or shrink the layout live with the [ and ] keys or the panel stepper - **Move**: drag a selected prop and the whole selection follows. Hold Alt to move just that one prop - **Group rotation**: hold right mouse button and drag (Alt snaps to 45 degrees), or use the panel buttons. Alt+scroll spins every selected prop around its own axis - **Ctrl+click picking**: grabs props stuck inside other objects or buildings where a normal click can't reach. Click the same spot again to cycle through the pile - **Height controls**: raise and lower with PgUp/PgDn, snap to ground with End, copy another prop's height with Home - **Delete**: removes the whole selection at once. Combined with the type filter it clears an overgrown forest in three clicks, and Ctrl+Z brings everything back with tree ages preserved - **Type filter**: press T and box selection only picks the prop type you point at. While active, clicking any prop switches the filter to its type - **Undo**: Ctrl+Z reverts move, rotate, align, height, delete and paste, up to 32 steps back - **Blueprints**: save a group to disk and use it in any city or save, colors included - **Anarchy-style pasting**: overlap errors are ignored while pasting (toggleable). The Anarchy mod is not required, but if you have it installed they cooperate - **Toolbar button + panel**: the panel can be dragged around and remembers where you left it. It shows counters, the selected prop's name and, for small selections, a per-prop list where hovering a row highlights that prop in the world and clicking keeps only it - All hotkeys rebindable, options in English and Serbian
## Usage Activate with Ctrl+Shift+C or the toolbar button. Select, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, click to place. A quick right-click always steps back.
## Transparency AI-assisted development: the code was written with heavy use of AI tools (Claude Fable), directed, reviewed and hand-tested in-game by the author through many iterations. Bug reports are read and fixed by a human.
Source code (MIT): https://github.com/viktorsx/Copaste
## Credits & thanks Copaste started as a personal tool and grew into this release. It was written from scratch, but the patterns and APIs were learned from open-source mods whose MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses explicitly welcome that. Sincere thanks to:
- **yenyang** — selection, highlighting and raycasting patterns learned from *Better Bulldozer*, *Anarchy*, *Tree Controller* and *Move It*; Anarchy's PreventOverride is integrated at runtime when present - **algernon** — the object placement approach (the game's definition pipeline) learned from *Line Tool* - **Bruceyboy24804** — *Node Controller* served as the reference for mod UI integration - **Colossal Order & Paradox** — for Cities: Skylines II and the official modding documentation - The **CS2 modding community** for keeping their mods open source
### Special thanks A very special thank-you to **Biffa** (Biffa Plays Indie Games) and **ConflictNerd**, simply for being the author's favorite Cities: Skylines YouTubers and the reason this game never gets boring. Keep the traffic flowing!
Publish.ChangeLog:
Panel redesign and quality-of-life update. Hand tested in game before publishing - that's the routine for every Copaste release.
Panel - Complete visual redesign: grouped cards, icons on every button, clear button states, readable counters - The panel can now be dragged by its header and remembers its position between sessions - Single click-selected props show their name in the panel (marquee selections don't) - Small selections (up to 15 props) get a Selected props list in the panel: hovering an entry rings that prop in the world, clicking it keeps only that prop selected - handy when a prop is hard to click directly - Blueprint and selected props lists are paged: 5 per page with arrows in the section header
Editing - Pasted props now keep the original's look by default - both the game's color variation and any custom color picked in the Customization tab. The Original/Random toggle in the panel restores the old random behavior - The paste preview shows the real colors too, instead of shuffling them while you move - Undo of a delete also restores the original colors now - New Align tools: Line makes a tidy row - straight line, equal gaps and all props rotated the same way; To prop does the same anchored to a reference prop you click (its position, facing and rotation); Circle arranges the selection evenly on a circle. The gap stepper sets exact meters; while an align button is lit, [ and ] keys (rebindable) or the stepper resize the layout live - Alt+drag moves a single prop out of the selection; Alt+mouse wheel spins every selected prop around its own axis (15 degree steps) - Ctrl+click cycles through props around the click point - picks up props partially buried in other objects or buildings that a normal click can never reach; click the same spot again to go to the next one - Move drag no longer jerks at the start - the selection follows the cursor smoothly from the first frame - Nudge (Ctrl+arrows) step halved for finer control
Blueprints - Blueprints now store color variations and custom colors too; older blueprint files still load fine
Options - Mod settings are now split into General and Key bindings tabs, with key bindings grouped by what they do
